## Name & positioning
- Product name: PromptShield
- One-line value: PromptShield scans an AI app for prompt-injection and jailbreak risk before you ship — paste untrusted input samples, get the patterns that fired, and a hardening checklist for LLM/agent product teams.
- Domain: https://promptshield.lxsaihub.com/

## FAQ
Q1. What is PromptShield?
A1. PromptShield scans AI apps for prompt-injection and jailbreak vulnerabilities before you ship.
Q2. What do I paste in?
A2. A short description of your AI app and samples of untrusted user input.
Q3. What does the report include?
A3. The patterns that fired plus a hardening checklist you can action.
Q4. Who should use it?
A4. LLM/agent product teams — developers and security partners shipping user-facing prompts.
Q5. Is it a penetration test?
A5. No. It is a decision-support risk pass, not a formal pentest or compliance attestation.
Q6. Does it guarantee a safe model?
A6. No. It surfaces likely injection/jailbreak patterns; you still own remediation and review.
